# s293 — Relay briefs label each agent and set its model and effort

Every agent a relay starts is labelled `ID role` and gets the model and reasoning effort from its role row set explicitly, so a harness's agent list shows which slice and role each agent serves and which model it runs.

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The owner asked on 2026-10-15, while watching the nested-relay trial, to see each subagent's model and effort in Claude Code's agent panel. The Claude Code docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline.md, "Subagent status lines"; sub-agents.md) say that `/tasks` lists each subagent with its model and effort, nested agents as a tree, and that the `subagentStatusLine` setting gets `model`, `effort`, `agentType`, `label`, `tokenCount` and `startTime` per task. The default panel row is name, description and tokens. The relay text says nothing about how an orchestrator labels an agent or whether it sets model and effort or lets them be inherited, so labels vary from run to run and an inherited model can differ from the matrix without anyone seeing it.

## Files

- `src/slicer/ai.py`, `## Every brief` in the relay text only: one paragraph. Start each agent with the model and reasoning effort its role row names, set explicitly rather than inherited from the session. Give it a short label `ID role`, for example `s279 implementer` or `s279 gate`, and the same `--task` line in `relay-run step`. Harness-neutral wording; no Claude Code names in `ai.py`.
- Do not change `## Order`, `## Setup`, the split text or anything about who orchestrates: the nested-orchestrator shape is in an owner trial and stays out of this slice.
- `docs/tui.md`, after the relay board: two sentences. In Claude Code, `/tasks` shows the same agents with model and effort, and the `subagentStatusLine` setting can put them in the agent panel row; link the Claude Code statusline docs.
- `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.
- `tests/test_relay_roles.py` (where the `test_AiRelay_*` tests live).

## Failing tests

- `test_AiRelay_EveryBrief_NamesLabelAndExplicitModelEffort`: the Every brief section says the label shape `ID role` and that model and reasoning effort are set explicitly from the role row.
- `test_AiRelay_EveryBrief_NamesNoHarness`: the Every brief section does not contain "Claude Code", "/tasks" or "subagentStatusLine".
